name: post view loads ZERO audio bytes: the inline feed splash must not fetch any music or SFX payload
description:
The inline (feed post) view shares one bundle with the expanded game view, so App.jsx used to construct every Audio() at module scope and preload ~7.5MB of music+SFX on every feed impression. Three fixes stack: (1) lazy construction in sound/basketball.js + sound/ui.js + components/BballTip.jsx - nothing calls `new Audio(src)` until a sound actually plays; (2) setAudioSuspended(true) in SplashCourt, which short-circuits every play/start entry point BEFORE construction; (3) suspend is released on unmount so the expanded game is unaffected. (2) is required because SplashCourt runs a REAL sim that genuinely calls playLeap/playJumpball/etc, so lazy alone still fetched them - and because mute could NOT be relied on: user.init resolves after mount and calls setMuted(user.muted), unmuting the splash for anyone whose saved preference is unmuted.

MEASUREMENT NOTE: under the Vite DEV server, `import x from './title.mp3'` fetches a ~600-byte ESM stub at /src/sound/title.mp3?import that merely exports the asset URL. Those stubs match a naive /\.mp3$/ filter but are NOT audio - they do not exist in a production build at all. This test therefore asserts on PAYLOADS: zero non-stub audio entries, and no audio-matching entry larger than 5KB (the smallest real SFX is ~10KB; game.mp3 is 4.04MB).

NON-VACUITY: the same run must show the sim actually played out, including actions whose code paths call playShot/playDunk/playPass, so 'no audio' cannot pass simply because nothing happened.

steps._comment: Post View proper is not a WebContentsView so the runner cannot attach to it. ?mode=inline mounts the identical inline branch (SplashCourt) in a normal webview. Cache-busting t= forces a fresh module load so module-scope side effects re-run.
Static ATTRACT mode runs no sim, which would make this test vacuous - nothing would call a sound function either way.

steps.until: (() => { window.__aud = window.__aud || {}; document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^="splash-player-"]').forEach(n => { const a = n.getAttribute('data-anim') || 'idle'; window.__aud[a] = (window.__aud[a] || 0) + 1; }); const act = Object.keys(window.__aud).filter(k => k !== 'idle' && k !== 'run'); const contact = ['shoot','shot','dunk','spindunk','block','ironblock','steal','pickpocket','pick','pass','leap','fadeaway']; return act.length >= 3 && contact.some(c => window.__aud[c] > 0); })()
steps._comment: Poll up to 30s accumulating animation states. Exits once the sim has demonstrably played out: >=3 distinct ACTION animations (anything other than idle/run) AND >=1 contact action. Grounded in useGame.js, which calls playJumpball/playPass/playLeap/playShot/playDunk/playBlock/playPick/bounceBall.start on these paths - so reaching this state proves sound-calling code executed.

Soak. The while loop exits as soon as its condition is met (sometimes ~2.5s), so this keeps the sim running for another 10s of possessions with measurement still open - any deferred or late fetch has ample time to land and register as a resource entry.
Histogram proving how much basketball actually got played during the measured window.

steps.expression: (() => { const a = performance.getEntriesByType('resource').filter(e => /\.(mp3|wav|ogg|m4a|aac)(\?|$)/i.test(e.name)); const real = a.filter(e => !/\?import/.test(e.name)); return 'matched=' + a.length + ' devStubs=' + (a.length - real.length) + ' realPayloads=' + real.length + ' maxDecoded=' + Math.max(0,...a.map(e=>e.decodedBodySize||0)) + ' sumTransfer=' + a.reduce((s,e)=>s+(e.transferSize||0),0); })()
steps._comment: THE HEADLINE NUMBERS. Expected: realPayloads=0, maxDecoded a few hundred bytes (stub-sized).
The two biggest files (4.04MB / 2.70MB) specifically. Must be STUB-only or absent.

steps.expression: (() => { document.querySelectorAll('#probe-no-payload,#probe-no-big-music,#probe-sim-ran').forEach(n=>n.remove()); const mk = id => { const d = document.createElement('div'); d.id = id; document.body.appendChild(d); }; const a = performance.getEntriesByType('resource').filter(e => /\.(mp3|wav|ogg|m4a|aac)(\?|$)/i.test(e.name)); const real = a.filter(e => !/\?import/.test(e.name)); const maxD = Math.max(0,...a.map(e=>e.decodedBodySize||0)); const bigReal = a.filter(e => /game\.mp3|title\.mp3/.test(e.name) && !/\?import/.test(e.name)); const aud = window.__aud||{}; const act = Object.keys(aud).filter(k => k !== 'idle' && k !== 'run'); const contact = ['shoot','shot','dunk','spindunk','block','ironblock','steal','pickpocket','pick','pass','leap','fadeaway'].filter(c => aud[c] > 0); if (real.length === 0 && maxD < 5000) mk('probe-no-payload'); if (bigReal.length === 0) mk('probe-no-big-music'); if (act.length >= 3 && contact.length >= 1) mk('probe-sim-ran'); return JSON.stringify({realPayloads: real.length, maxDecoded: maxD, bigReal: bigReal.length, actionAnims: act, contactAnims: contact}); })()

steps._comment: NON-VACUITY GATE: >=3 distinct sound-triggering actions occurred. If this fails the assertions below prove nothing.
ASSERTION 1: no real fetch of game.mp3 (4.04MB) or title.mp3 (2.70MB) - the bulk of the old ~9MB.
ASSERTION 2 (strict): zero non-stub audio entries AND no audio-matching entry over 5KB. Resource entries are recorded for cache hits too, so a warm cache cannot mask a regression.

steps.expression: (() => { if (!location.search) return 'already-clean'; location.href = location.origin + location.pathname; return 'restored expanded view'; })()
steps._comment: TEARDOWN: this test navigates the shared webview to ?mode=inline, and a reload PRESERVES the query string - so without this, every later test that expects the expanded app (none of them declare a `url`) boots into the inline splash and times out. Same idiom already used at the end of splash-special-move-cards.json.
Let the reload land so the next test starts from the expanded view. Deliberately does NOT waitFor lobby-screen: a teardown must never be able to fail the test it is attached to.
